title: Reticuline alleviates rheumatoid arthritis by suppressing the JAK/STAT signaling pathway.
authors: Tian, Jimei; Zhang, Jinyu; Yang, Yibo; Song, Yali; Yuan, Ziqi; Chang, Sheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然生物碱Reticuline通过抑制JAK/STAT信号通路缓解类风湿关节炎，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法亦非AI或物理模拟，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic autoimmune disorder characterized by persistent inflammation and progressive joint destruction, in which aberrant activation of the JAK/STAT signaling pathway plays a central pathogenic role. Although JAK inhibitors are utilized in clinical practice, emerging limitations such as potential resistance underscore the need to identify novel therapeutic modulators. Reticuline, a natural isoquinoline alkaloid, has not been systematically investigated for its anti‑arthritic efficacy or mechanism of action. METHODS: In this study, we integrated network pharmacology, molecular docking, in vitro assays, and a collagen‑induced arthritis (CIA) mouse model to comprehensively evaluate the therapeutic potential of reticuline and elucidate its underlying mechanisms. RESULTS: Network analysis predicted the JAK‑STAT pathway as a primary pathway involved. Molecular docking results suggested that reticuline could potentially bind to the ATP-binding pocket of JAK2, forming five hydrogen bonds. In TNF‑alpha‑stimulated human synovial fibroblasts (MH7A), reticuline (10 and 20 microM) significantly suppressed cell migration and intracellular ROS generation, downregulated IL‑6 mRNA, and upregulated IL‑10 and IL-1beta mRNA expression. Importantly, reticuline markedly inhibited the phosphorylation and mRNA expression of JAK2 and STAT3. In CIA mice, reticuline administration (0.5 and 1 mg/kg/day) substantially reduced clinical arthritis scores, synovial hyperplasia, and bone erosion, while modulating serum cytokine profiles (lowering TNF‑alpha, IL‑1beta, and IL‑17, and elevating IL‑10). Consistent with the cellular findings, reticuline also attenuated activation of the JAK2/STAT3 pathway in joint tissues. CONCLUSION: In summary, this work provides the first systematic preclinical evidence that reticuline ameliorates RA pathology by suppressing the JAK2/STAT3 signaling cascade, positioning it as a promising preclinical candidate, providing a foundation for further translational development of reticuline for RA treatment. Keypoints * Reticuline ameliorates rheumatoid arthritis by suppressing the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway, reducing inflammation and joint destruction both in vitro and in vivo. * This study provides the first systematic evidence integrating network pharmacology, cellular assays, and a disease model to establish reticuline as a natural JAK/STAT inhibitor for RA.
abstract_zh: 背景：类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种慢性自身免疫性疾病，以持续性炎症和进行性关节破坏为特征，其中JAK/STAT信号通路的异常激活在发病机制中起核心作用。尽管JAK抑制剂已在临床中应用，但新出现的局限性（如潜在耐药性）凸显了识别新型治疗调节因子的必要性。Reticuline是一种天然异喹啉生物碱，其抗关节炎疗效或作用机制尚未被系统研究。方法：在本研究中，我们整合了网络药理学、分子对接、体外实验和胶原诱导性关节炎（CIA）小鼠模型，全面评估reticuline的治疗潜力并阐明其潜在机制。结果：网络分析预测JAK-STAT通路为涉及的主要通路。分子对接结果表明，reticuline可能结合至JAK2的ATP结合口袋，形成五个氢键。在TNF-α刺激的人滑膜成纤维细胞（MH7A）中，reticuline（10和20微摩尔）显著抑制细胞迁移和细胞内ROS生成，下调IL-6 mRNA，并上调IL-10和IL-1β mRNA表达。重要的是，reticuline显著抑制JAK2和STAT3的磷酸化及mRNA表达。在CIA小鼠中，reticuline给药（0.5和1 mg/kg/天）显著降低临床关节炎评分、滑膜增生和骨侵蚀，同时调节血清细胞因子谱（降低TNF-α、IL-1β和IL-17，升高IL-10）。与细胞实验结果一致，reticuline还减弱了关节组织中JAK2/STAT3通路的激活。结论：总之，本研究提供了首个系统性临床前证据，表明reticuline通过抑制JAK2/STAT3信号级联改善RA病理，将其定位为有前景的临床前候选药物，为reticuline治疗RA的进一步转化开发奠定了基础。要点 * Reticuline通过抑制JAK2/STAT3信号通路改善类风湿关节炎，在体外和体内均减少炎症和关节破坏。 * 本研究提供了首个整合网络药理学、细胞实验和疾病模型的系统性证据，确立reticuline为用于RA的天然JAK/STAT抑制剂。
